display_long_description:
# WELCOME TO THE ONLY OFFICIALLY LICENSED MAJOR LEAGUE BASEBALL GAME IN VR!

Crush towering home runs, chase record-breaking scores, and own the derby.

# NEW!!  Citizens Bank Park Gets the All-Star Treatment
The stadium is ready for baseball's biggest showcase! Citizens Bank Park has been decked out with special 2026 All-Star Game decorations, bringing the excitement and atmosphere of the Midsummer Classic to every game you play.

[media]
# GO BIG in MLB’s Home Run Derby VR
Welcome to the only officially licensed Major League Baseball game in VR!  Every team, every ballpark, right here and no place else.


# Experience the Thrill of a Real Home Run Derby
Feel the crack of the bat every swing with realistic physics and intuitive motion controls in REAL MLB Ballparks.

# Be the Best
Compete against other players as you climb the leaderboards and earn incentives, unlocking bats, gloves, trophies and more..


# Build a Legacy
Invite friends to your custom clubhouse, decorated with earned items showcasing your big accomplishments and unique style.  

**Plus: Watch the latest MLB news and highlights on the big screen from the best seat in the house!**

# More Than Just a Game, it's a Major League Baseball Experience...

Home Run Derby VR puts you in the heart of baseball's most electrifying contest. Step into the batter's box, grip your bat and unleash your inner slugger in a stunning, immersive VR experience.
Download Home Run Derby VR today and become a legend!
